locator: I q.14 a.1 co.: immaterialitas alicuius rei est ratio quod sit cognoscitiva
interpretation: Immateriality is the reason why a thing is cognitive, and the mode of knowledge follows the mode of immateriality: plants do not know because of their materiality, sense knows because it receives species without matter, intellect knows more because it is more separate from matter; God, in the highest degree of immateriality, is in the highest degree of knowledge. Read as: what is in no way composed of matter and form has intellect. Interpretive step: the highest grade of immateriality is taken as intellectual.
